_readme: Copy this file to ~/.claude/qa-config.json and fill in your own values. Every skill in the qa-workflow plugin reads it. Secrets never go in here - only the NAMES of environment variables that hold them. Set the actual secrets in ~/.claude/settings.json under 'env'.

jira._note_product_field: Optional. If your Jira project tags work items by product/app with a custom field, set its id and the value you test. Leave null to disable all product filtering.
jira._note_exclusions: Optional. accountIds whose tickets CE-ForTesting should skip (other QA members, bots). Leave empty to consider every unassigned ticket.

prod.label: Production
prod._warning: Set default_env to 'prod' only for read-only production smoke checks. Tokens must have read-only scope.

xray._note: Xray Cloud endpoints are the same for every tenant - no need to change them.

github._note: Optional. Used by CE-AC-Validator and CE-QA-Workflow to find the PR and commits behind a ticket. 'org' scopes the `gh api search/issues` query. 'alt_key_prefixes' lists any second key system your developers use in branch and PR titles (e.g. a dev-side tracker) so a search on the Jira key alone does not come back empty.

report_portal._note: Optional. Only used by CE-AutomationVSManual. Leave null if you do not run ReportPortal.

automation._note: Optional. Local checkout of your Selenium/Playwright regression repo, and the mapping file CE-AutomationVSManual reads. See references/te-mapping.md for the mapping file format.

regression_cycle._note: Optional. Only used by Regression-Cycle-Setup. Leave 'executions' empty to disable the skill. Each entry is one Test Execution in your release cycle: 'summary' is its exact name (no date or release suffix - the Test Plan tells cycles apart), 'test_set' is the Test Set it is filled from, and 'map' / 'keys_map' names the assignment map that sets its run assignees. Two executions may share a Test Set.
regression_cycle._note_maps_dir: Where the assignment maps live. Keep it OUTSIDE the plugin directory - /plugin update overwrites plugin files - and out of source control, because the maps hold real Jira account ids. See skills/Regression-Cycle-Setup/references/*.example.json for the two formats.
regression_cycle._note_work_breakdown: Optional. A single-select custom field your project stamps on every new Test Execution. Set both ids, or leave null to create executions without it.
regression_cycle._note_map_vs_keys_map: Use 'map' (folder-based, assignment-map.example.json) when the Test Set's tests are filed under module folders. Use 'keys_map' (group-based, group-map.example.json) when they all sit in one flat folder and have to be grouped by test key instead.
